0.original: U'jughal needs a strong adventurer to eliminate the dread pirate Drysnagl.

1.original: U'jughal wants you to hunt down Dawson's impostor, Drysnagl. Slip into the Serpent's Tongue and hunt down the dread pirate.

2.original: You have delivered Drysnagl his comeuppance. Report the good news to U'jughal.

3.original: U'jughal breathes easier knowing there is one less Serpent Reaver to worry about.

24.original: Slay Drysnagl in the Serpent's Tongue.

48.original: Have to hand it to the villain Drysnagl─he's got gall. Most men wanted for sixty-four counts wouldn't dare leave the safety of the Serpent's Tongue. No doubt he's scurried back there by now.

49.original: It's only a matter of time until the crystals end up in Sahagin hands and we're all drowning in Leviathan's wake.

50.original: Drysnagl's a cutthroat among cutthroats─he wields his axe with sharp wits and crushing strength.

51.original: Needless to say, seeking him out and rendering justice will be far from easy. The Navigator guide your blade!

54.original: Ha! And here I feared I was sending you to your death! Glad you gave that rapscallion Drysnagl his comeuppance!

55.original: A <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03> who can dispense justice will always have a place by my side.
